description:
This file defines the MonkeyTouchEvent class, which extends MonkeyMotionEvent, representing touch input events in the Android Monkey tool.
It includes a constructor to initialize the event with a specific action, and overrides getTypeLabel() to return 'Touch'.

classes.name: MonkeyTouchEvent
classes.description: Represents a touch event in the Android Monkey testing tool, specifying the type of event and source.

methods.name: MonkeyTouchEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a touch event with a specific action, setting the event type and source.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Returns the string 'Touch' to label the type of event.
